Aqueous solubility.blurb: Aqueous solubility (AqSolDB, log mol/L). A single-endpoint ADMET property with no 'other target' to compare against - yet the same 'similar structure -> similar property' assumption, and the same cliffs that break it, appear just as they do for binding.

Lipophilicity.blurb: Lipophilicity (AstraZeneca, logD at pH 7.4). Another continuous ADMET endpoint; a single-atom change can still move it sharply.

Caco-2 permeability.blurb: Caco-2 apparent permeability (Wang et al., log cm/s) - a common proxy for intestinal absorption. A third, smaller ADMET endpoint: we can't know in advance how cliff-riddled it is, nor which fingerprint will happen to track its cliffs.
